    Inspect editable vector layers

    Source: R/cttir-design.R
    hex_layers.Rd

    Inspect editable vector layers

    Usage

    hex_layers(design)

    Arguments

    design

    A hex_design() object.

    Value

    A data frame with stable IDs, geometry type and current colour roles.

    Examples

    hex_layers(hex_design("phenoscapR"))
